notes.title: Update 12
notes.content:
Update 12 has been released!
Key changes include the introduction of Tractors, the inclusion of a Rock and Heavy Metal radio station, a comprehensive overhaul of the map, and updates to vehicle models and shaders.

Explore the latest development diary for a detailed analysis:
[previewyoutube=bZe5XDXDUkI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Here is the full list of changes:[/h1]

[h2]ADDED:[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Map menu
[*]     Map zoom/pan
[*]     Map icon interaction
[*]     Tractor - HDZetor 69420
[*]     New radio stations
[*]     Radio station switching
[*]     Radio playing at many buildings and locations
[*]     New NPC: Plowking Pete
[*]     New NPC Questgiver: Michael Chickumacher
[*]     New house in Fartsville
[*]     New song added to Country Radio
[/list]

[h2]CHANGED:[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Day/Night shadow intensity
[*]     Morning and sunset light intensity
[*]     Sun color
[*]     Water rendering
[*]     Sunshafts intensity
[*]     Map Icons - New, more readable map icons
[*]     Yugo 45 ax - no longer has changeable front bumpers, back bumpers, and side skirts; now they are all merged into one big part called "Body Kit". If you had certain items unlocked, you will have an equal body kit unlocked by default; you just have to go to the garage to equip it.
[*]     Yugo 45 ax - updated the interior and exterior designs
[*]     Krom 80 - also had its interior and exterior design updated
[*]     Car interior view - you can now look around the car's interior a bit while holding down the look interaction (right Mouse Button + moving it around or the right stick for the gamepad)
[*]     Car interior - the dials on the dashboard and the pedals now move as you drive the car
[*]     Car shaders - Proper emission
[/list]

[*]  Garage UI losing selection when navigating to the customization menu when the only option is to paint the car
[*]     Garage UI - snapping to navigation elements stops working after a few menu changes (should also be fixed in some other menus where there is scroll snapping)

[/list]

notes.title: Update 10
notes.content:
Racing with online leaderboards and ultimate abilities rework!

[previewyoutube=w6BJXMOY5Ig;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Here is the full list of changes:[/h1]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Gates of Bootylon now spawns 3 portals, increasing by 1 with each upgrade.
[*]     Gates of Bootylon portals now shoot the same projectiles as the player.
[*]     Gates of Bootylon now unlocks at level 60. If you had it unlocked at level 20 and your level is less than the new unlock level, you will have the feathers refunded.
[*]     Laser Eyes: Increased the base damage significantly and increased the damage with each upgrade by a lot.
[*]     Meteor Shower: Models have been changed to rocks. Meteors now deal 50 damage per meteor. Reduced the number of meteors that are spawned, but a certain number of meteors will now target enemies wherever you point the meteor shower to drop. Increased the meteor shower radius to make it easier to hit targets. Increased the velocity at which they are launched to 120 from 100.
[*]     Super Chikiyan: You are now invulnerable for the whole duration of Super Chikiyan, and the damage increases significantly with each upgrade (basically by 100% every upgrade). The duration has been reduced significantly at the beginning, but at max upgrade, it should last around a minute.
[*]     Stepping into water will now remove Burn Debuffs.
[*]     Rage is now saved.
[*]     Projectiles: Made the VFX a bit more explosive.
[*]     Main menu & pause menu: Will now again show a prompt for quitting the game.
[*]     Added racing.
[*]     Mini-map size increased.
[*]     Fartsville race track
[/list]

[h2]Added:[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Sound effects for burning and poisoned status.
[*]     Sound effects for all 4 of the ultimate abilities.
[*]     Racing with online leaderboards
[*]     3 new songs to the radio
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*]     Projectile augment: The name and icon should now properly update in the effects view when a different projectile augment is applied.
[*]     Fire projectile ability: You can no longer shoot projectiles while the laser ability is active.
[*]     Meteors: Will now properly disappear when hitting objects.
[*]     Ultimate abilities: You should no longer be able to use ultimate abilities while driving or interacting with objects while in the process of using an ultimate.
[*]     Super Chikiyan and Gates of Bootylon: Rage is no longer spent while the ultimate animation is performed.
[*]     Buffs/debuffs with an infinite duration are now properly displayed.
[*]     Resoution settings were not working as they should
[/list]

notes.title: Turbo Chicken Simulator is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear Turbo Chicken Enthusiasts,

We are thrilled to announce that Turbo Chicken Simulator has officially launched on Steam, and it's been an exhilarating [b]24 hours since the release[/b]! We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for your overwhelming support and enthusiasm.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]

Get ready for a cluckin' good time because the fun has just begun! We are committed to making Turbo Chicken Simulator an eggstraordinary experience for all players. To ensure you stay hooked, we are rolling out a brand new update every Friday, packed with more content, challenges, and surprises.

[h3]Join Our Community:[/h3]

Turbo Chicken Simulator is not just a game; it's a community of passionate enthusiasts! We invite you to be part of our growing community and share your thoughts, ideas, and feedback with us. Your input is invaluable, and we want to hear from you about your favorite features, requested additions, and any pesky bugs you might encounter.

[h3]Day one patch was released right now:[/h3]
-Fixing the mouse sensitivity problem
-Fixing the multiple interaction problem
-Adding the option to change grass density
-Some other minor changes

Once again, thank you for your fantastic support. Turbo Chicken Simulator is a labor of love, and we can't wait to continue this clucktastic journey with you!

Feathered Regards,
Balkanware
